items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: And Chris Kelly, I had them all come here to want music then.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was, his time and the division and all that.

Yeah. He noticed all, but he couldn't, he wasn't sure he could count, you know. Yeah. The division, you know. He didn't show he could count. He, he come out and eat with me. I've been him playing it about four times. Yeah. And I told him, I said, you can go. But after he played, I know some of them fellas, you put them in them shop keys and four and five flats, they- Yeah. They could read it all right. Some of them, they couldn't read it, you understand. They had routine, I played all right. But they used to call…

I used to have some better. I was going to ask some more about the trombone, the two brothers, Yank and Buddy. Which was the better trombone, do you think, Mooney? Which would you rather hear? If you had your choice to hear, was one of them better than the other? I was about to say.
